english.title: Possess salmon/trout/instrument/explosive/poison to take or destroy fish in Tweed district
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) obtained possession of

(A)_[salmon]_
(B)_[trout]_
(C)_[an instrument, namely **(..SPECIFY INSTRUMENT..),]_
(D)_[explosives, namely **(..SPECIFY EXPLOSIVES..),]_
(E)_[a poison or other noxious substance, namely **(..SPECIFY POISON OR NOXIOUS SUBSTANCE..), ]_

(F)_[as the result]_
(G)_[for the purpose]_

of

(H)_[using that explosive substance with intent to take or destroy fish in waters in the Tweed district at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..)]_
(I)_[using an explosive substance, namely **(..SPECIFY SUBSTANCE..), with intent to take or destroy fish in waters in the Tweed district at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..)]_
(J)_[putting that substance in or near waters in the Tweed district at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) with intent to take or destroy fish]_
(K)_[putting a poison or other noxious substance, namely **(..SPECIFY SUBSTANCE..), in or near waters in the Tweed district at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) with intent to take or destroy fish]_
(L)_[using an electrical device, namely **(..SPECIFY DEVICE..), with intent to stun or destroy salmon or freshwater fish in waters in the Tweed district at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..)]_
(M)_[attempting to use, or doing an act preparatory to using, that explosive substance with intent to take or destroy fish in waters in the Tweed district at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..)]_
(N)_[attempting to use, or doing an act preparatory to using, an explosive substance, namely **(..SPECIFY SUBSTANCE..), with intent to take or destroy fish in waters in the Tweed district at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..)]_
(O)_[attempting to put, or doing an act preparatory to putting, that substance in or near waters in the Tweed district at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..)with intent to take or destroy fish]_
(P)_[attempting to put, or doing an act preparatory to putting, a poison or other noxious substance, namely **(..SPECIFY POISON OR SUBSTANCE..), in or near waters in the Tweed district at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..)with intent to take or destroy fish]_
(Q)_[attempting to use, or doing an act preparatory to using, an electrical device, namely **(..SPECIFY DEVICE..), with intent to stun or destroy salmon or freshwater fish in waters in the Tweed district at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 26 and 30 of the Scotland Act 1998 (River Tweed) Order 2006.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
found in possession of any salmon or trout OR
instrument, explosive, poison or other noxious substance
which could be used in the taking of fish in Tweed district
for the purpose of committing an offence against
a provisions of article 26

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Either way -

Summary: maximum 3 months imprisonment and / or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
